title: Concavity of bivariate Gaussian stability
statement: Let $\rho,b\in(0,1)$. For $a\in[0,1]$, consider the probability that a pair of independent standard Gaussian random variables $(Z_1,Z_2)$ satisfies $\Phi(Z_1)\le a$ and $\Phi\!\left(\rho Z_1+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}Z_2\right)\le b$, where $\Phi$ is the standard Gaussian distribution function. As a function of $a$, this probability is concave on $[0,1]$.
